W.calibration: Frontal west-elevation proxy. Modern west photographs have no usable camera position in the downloaded metadata; elevation fit is approximate, not an exact photo solve.

S.camera_height_basis: 1.7 m above nominal project grade is an eye-level approximation; absolute EXIF altitude cannot be transferred without a verified church-ground elevation.
S.sensor_width_basis: M05 is a 2464x3696 portrait image with 30 mm full-frame-equivalent focal length recorded in Commons metadata. The active horizontal 35-mm-equivalent width is approximately 23.4 mm for this 2:3 format; the source dimensions determine the portrait framing.
S.local_position_basis: M05 GPS converts to approximately [-35.1, -36.3, 1.7] m from the inferred crossing anchor in data/coordinate_system.yaml; GPS location and recorded 30 mm equivalent focal length are retained. M05 has no heading, so target [0, -10, 23] m is a documented visual-fit candidate selected to align the south nave roof, roof turret and east choir in the source composition. This aim remains inferred. The separate M04 GPS photo remains unresolved: its converted camera point falls inside the coarse south-conch mass and available offset diagnostics fail.

SE.camera_height_basis: 1.7 m above nominal project grade is an eye-level approximation; absolute EXIF altitude cannot be transferred without a verified church-ground elevation.
SE.sensor_width_basis: M02 is a 3696x3053 crop from a Nikon D5100 (APS-C), with 27 mm full-frame-equivalent focal length. The 1.21 image aspect uses an active horizontal 35-mm-equivalent width of approximately 23.4 mm x 3696/3053 = 28.3 mm. This models the saved crop without inventing camera metadata.
SE.local_position_basis: GPS converted using the inferred approximate crossing coordinate in data/coordinate_system.yaml. M02 has no heading. After correcting the active sensor width to match the 3696x3053 crop, direct comparison showed the tower pair and roof turret still left of their source positions; diagnostic re-aims toward [-15, 0, 25] shifted them toward the source without changing GPS location or focal length. The iteration-6 candidate target [-15, 0, 29] also moves the model down slightly to match the photo's near-full-height framing. This is a camera-fit inference only; the roof/conch silhouette residual remains open.

N.calibration: Orthographic north-elevation proxy from the modern north views; exact camera pose is unavailable.

E.calibration: Orthographic historic east-elevation proxy. No modern direct-east photograph is present in the curated dataset.

NE.calibration: Raised northeast geometry-reference view only; camera pose is approximate because the source set has no matching solved-camera metadata.

TOP.calibration: Top-down plan check; M01 is an oblique aerial and is used for roof geometry only, not as a camera solve.
